prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:

Choose_path copy, home redesign, adoption redesign, adoption incentive, and home new_screen changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Stage Wait Notification Display: Enables progress indicators, time estimates, and ready system notifications on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Home step has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; previous home wait_info tests won 4 out of 5 times.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Sync Safety Assurance Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in secures pet custom data and prevents account resets across app launches. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in hint changes have a strong win rate (5 of 9).)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interactive Controls Setup Sub-Flow: Adds test buttons on the home intro screen letting users interactively hide and call their pet before completing onboarding. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Quality Verification Screen: Inserts a new photo review screen (new_photo_check) before adoption certificate to confirm uploaded photos meet 3D rendering standards. (why: Adoption step drops off at 66.0% conversion and 3 support tickets complained about custom pet generation failures or distorted models.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatch Status Tip Carousel Wait Info: Adds an auto-advancing tip carousel component with a 15-second delay to keep users informed while waiting for pet rendering. (why: Users spend up to 2336s on the home rendering step, and wait_info changes on home have consistently proven effective.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Session Recovery Account Protection Hint: Adds an explicit session security hint to the sign-in screen emphasizing cloud restoration of companion progress. (why: Addresses the top support topic (8 emails about pets missing or reset after re-login) using proven sign-in hint patterns.)
6: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Preview Layout: Changes the adoption certificate screen layout to split mode, presenting pet adoption details side-by-side with companion verification. (why: Adoption step has the biggest funnel drop-off (66.0% conversion, 89s median time), requiring clearer visual structure.)
7: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Story Scroll Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a story_scroll layout to guide users smoothly through path options. (why: 79.7% conversion on choose_path with high mean duration (514s) suggests user indecision during early path selection.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Shortcut Setup Notification Switch: Enables a notify-when-ready switch and hint on the final screen describing desktop shortcut hotkeys. (why: 3 support emails mentioned post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide or summon their companion on desktop.)
